title.zh: Codex 的隔离：沙箱管目录，令牌管仓库
title.en: Codex isolation: the sandbox owns directories, the token owns the repository

summary.zh: 本地沙箱决定能写这台机器上的哪些目录，细粒度令牌决定能改 GitHub 上的哪个仓库。两层各管一件事，缺一不可；这篇把边界、实测结果和剩下的口子都写清楚。
summary.en: The local sandbox decides which directories on this machine may be written; a fine-grained token decides which repository on GitHub may be changed. The two layers cover different questions and neither replaces the other. The boundary, the measurements, and the openings that remain.
